none.description:
{Acid Burst - Basic level}

Reduces the Defence of the target enemy unit by {1}.

At the start of each subsequent turn, the unit's Defence is reduced by another {1} point, up to a maximum reduction of {10} points.

The spell's duration depends on the hero's {Spell Power}.

basic.description:
{Acid Burst - Basic level}

Reduces the Defence of the target enemy unit by {1}.

At the start of each subsequent turn, the unit's Defence is reduced by another {1} point, up to a maximum reduction of {10} points.

The spell's duration depends on the hero's {Spell Power}.

advanced.description:
{Acid Burst - Advanced level}

Reduces the Attack and Defence of the target enemy unit by {1}.

At the start of each subsequent turn, the unit's Attack and Defence are each reduced by another {1} point, up to a maximum reduction of {10} points for each stat.

The spell's duration depends on the hero's {Spell Power}.

expert.description:
{Acid Burst - Expert level}

Reduces the Attack and Defence of all enemy units by {1}.

At the start of each subsequent turn, the Attack and Defence of all affected units are each reduced by another {1} point, up to a maximum reduction of {10} points for each stat.

The spell's duration depends on the hero's {Spell Power}.
